title: Electropolis
physical_identity: Monochromatic mid-20th-century industrial metropolis of brutalist buildings under a void sky, lit by pulsing floodlights on towers and struck by lightning.
scale_topology: Hypothetically endless outdoor city plane; skyscrapers with interior rooms; furthest traversal 3.5 km.
anomalies: High-voltage bolts from the void at unmeasured intervals
Concussive thunder causing disorientation and temporary hearing loss
Throne of Zeus skyscraper structurally disappeared
lighting_sound: No stars; floods on exoskeletal towers pulse; constant storm; thunder 'torrential/headsplitting', sternum and skull pressure.

entities.name: The Windows
entities.behavior: Intermittently appear in reflective glass of skyscrapers; not in interiors

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Windows (humans also present)
items_communities: Antenna to Heaven outpost (inactive, all personnel dead)
Electrostatic Discharge Power Plant (failure log only)

entrances.method: Doors in Level 3 lead to a door in skyscrapers here
entrances.quote: Doors within Level 3 may occasionally lead to another door located within the skyscrapers of this level.
No-clipping through the concrete of Level 1 may, rarely, result in your arrival at this level.

entrances.method: Shatter object with electrostatic discharge; blast no-clips everyone inside
entrances.quote: will result in a massive explosion that no-clips everyone caught within the blast into this level.

exits.method: No-clip directly into an electrostatic discharge
exits.quote: No-clipping directly into an electrostatic discharge may transport you to Level 3 .

signature_mechanic: Unpredictable lethal lightning strikes with concussive thunder outdoors; skyscraper interiors are safe; only extraction is to enter a discharge.
verticality: Skyscrapers and a spired tower with interior rooms; no stairs or elevators described.
conflicts_notes: Access section flattened (Entrance/Extraction tabs merged); direction inferred from wording. Level 4, 3.4, 3.6 appear only as link targets.

key_quotes.quote: hypothetically endless plane that manifests itself as a monochromatic mid-20th-century industrial metropolis
Aside from humans , only the Windows are present within the level
prolonged exposure outdoors will invariably result in expiration
successful extraction is considered highly improbable
No-clipping directly into an electrostatic discharge may transport you to Level 3 .
